WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>') AS funding_source,
         AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS source_size
  FROM scanspatial AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>')
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size
  FROM source_stats
)
SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
       SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(ss.source_size - o.avg_size) AS average_excess_size
FROM source_stats AS ss
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ss.source_size > o.avg_size
